mara.activity: Wake, wash my face, brush my teeth, and get dressed in comfortable daytime clothes. I collect my phone from the nightstand by the wardrobe and leave the reading glasses on the nightstand by my bed.
mara.intention: Start quietly and keep the morning predictable.

mara.activity: Make coffee and carry the mug to the dining table. I eat a small breakfast and leave the mug there while I look over the kitchen after yesterday's outage.
mara.intention: Have something steady before doing any household work.

mara.activity: Collect the grouped dishes and glasses from the living room and carry them to the kitchen. I wash the most vulnerable pieces, wipe the dining table, and leave the remaining kitchen things arranged for later rather than doing a deep clean.
mara.intention: Put the apartment back into ordinary order without overcorrecting.

mara.activity: Sort the remaining laundry and put away anything dry. I carry the laundry hamper between the bedroom and the laundry area, leaving an unfinished load for another time if needed.
mara.intention: Finish yesterday's practical tasks at a manageable pace.

mara.activity: Read with breakfast and plan the coming editing week at the dining table. I carry my book and blue reading-glasses case from the bedroom, write a short list in my notebook, and return the book face-down with its receipt marking the page to the small shelving unit by the sofa when I finish.
mara.intention: Keep my usual Sunday planning block and make the week feel contained.

mara.activity: Stay out of Julian's way while he prepares his usual large lunch. I set out a plate and drinking glass for myself when the meal is ready, carry them to the dining table, and eat without assuming he will want a long conversation.
mara.intention: Share lunch while allowing for his unpredictable energy and timing.

mara.activity: Carry my plate and glass to the kitchen, wash them, and put any food Julian has designated as leftovers into the leftover container. I leave the kitchen ready for the afternoon.
mara.intention: Clear my part of lunch without taking over his cooking or packing.

mara.activity: Do a contained editing block in the bedroom. I take the canvas folder from the desk, remove the current proof pages, open the laptop, review and mark a limited section, then save the work and return the proof pages to the folder.
mara.intention: Make useful progress without allowing Sunday planning to become a full workday.

mara.activity: Close the laptop and take a quiet break with water. I carry my reading glasses to the living room in their blue case and sit briefly, observing whether Julian seems available for conversation rather than pressing him.
mara.intention: Reset before the evening preparation and remain attentive without monitoring him.

mara.activity: Prepare simple meals and label the week's leftovers. I carry ingredients and containers to the kitchen, make a salad and portion what needs saving, then wipe the counter. I put the tea bag and small brass spoon on the sink-cabinet countertop for later and leave the spoon there.
mara.intention: Follow my usual Sunday meal preparation while keeping it simple after Julian's lunch.

mara.activity: Make tea and carry it to the living room. I read a little or talk with Julian if the timing feels natural, leaving the mug on the end table when my hands are occupied.
mara.intention: Have an unstructured pause before the evening rather than forcing a schedule.

mara.activity: Make a light dinner from the prepared food, carry plates and water to the dining table, and eat with Julian. I keep conversation flexible because his energy may be brisk or unexpectedly lively.
mara.intention: End the active part of the day with a manageable shared meal.

mara.activity: Carry the dishes to the kitchen, wash them, and leave the labeled leftovers together in the refrigerator. I do only the necessary cleanup.
mara.intention: Finish the kitchen without turning tiredness into another project.

mara.activity: Shower, change into evening clothes, and settle the bedroom for sleep. I use moisturizer and hand cream, then leave the reading glasses on the top of the nightstand by the bed.
mara.intention: Shift out of work and prepare for a quiet night.

mara.activity: Read a few pages in bed, carrying the book from the living room and returning it to the small shelving unit by the sofa afterward. I put the phone on charge by the wardrobe, out of arm's reach.
mara.intention: Close the day gently and preserve the phone-free bedroom routine.

mara.activity: Turn out the light, put on the sleep mask, and sleep.
mara.intention: Rest before the Monday deadlines begin.

julian.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, check my temperature, and sit on the edge of the bed while I work out the new commute timing.
julian.intention: Start carefully and understand the practical change before getting moving.

julian.activity: Wash, brush my teeth, get dressed in work clothes, and put my sleep clothes in the hamper.
julian.intention: Get ready for an earlier or differently timed museum day without rushing.

julian.activity: Make a quick breakfast and coffee, eat in the kitchen, and rinse the mug and bowl at the sink.
julian.intention: Have something substantial enough for the changed commute.

julian.activity: Pack my laptop and work materials, fill my travel mug and water bottle, and check that my badge and keys are with me.
julian.intention: Create a reliable departure routine for the new schedule.

julian.activity: Put on my jacket, collect my badge and keys from the hallway tray, and leave for the museum using the revised commute.
julian.intention: Leave with enough margin to test the new transition rather than arriving flustered.

julian.activity: Work at the museum under the new Sunday schedule, noting the changed start and commute pattern and handling the day’s exhibition tasks.
julian.intention: Make the altered routine workable and identify what needs adjusting in future weeks.

julian.activity: Return home, put my badge and keys in the hallway tray, and make a straightforward lunch rather than attempting an elaborate Sunday cooking session.
julian.intention: Restore a clear home transition and eat before fatigue builds.

julian.activity: Eat lunch at the kitchen island and pack the remaining food into a leftover container for another meal.
julian.intention: Keep lunch practical while preserving food for the week.

julian.activity: Wash the plate and cooking things, clear the oil and wooden spoon from the island, and leave the kitchen in a usable state.
julian.intention: Finish the lunch transition instead of carrying kitchen clutter into the afternoon.

julian.activity: Rest on the large sofa with my phone nearby, keeping museum notifications quiet while I let the new commute settle.
julian.intention: Recover from the workday without losing the afternoon entirely.

julian.activity: Call my mother from the sofa and tell her about the museum schedule change, treating it as a puzzle rather than complaining about it.
julian.intention: Keep my usual Sunday call and hear an outside perspective.

julian.activity: Read the weekend newspapers on the large sofa, making a few notes about the commute timing and leaving the papers there for now.
julian.intention: Keep the familiar Sunday rhythm while thinking through the new routine.

julian.activity: Review the week ahead and write a short practical checklist for museum transitions, including what to pack and when to leave.
julian.intention: Convert mild resentment into a repeatable plan.

julian.activity: Take a shower, change into comfortable evening clothes, and put my work clothes in the hamper.
julian.intention: Mark the end of the changed workday and reset at home.

julian.activity: Make a light evening meal from the lunch leftovers, heat it safely, and leave the cooking oil and wooden spoon on the island while I work.
julian.intention: Use what is already prepared and avoid overcommitting after the schedule change.

julian.activity: Eat at the dining table, drink water, and put the used plate and utensils by the sink afterward.
julian.intention: Have a calm meal without making the evening another project.

julian.activity: Put the leftover container in the fridge, wash the saucepan and plate, and finally clear the oil and wooden spoon from the island.
julian.intention: Complete the delayed kitchen reset before settling down.

julian.activity: Read quietly in the living room, with the phone on silent, and leave the weekend newspapers on the sofa rather than reorganising the room.
julian.intention: Have an unstructured recovery period after the first day of the new routine.

julian.activity: Prepare for bed, brush my teeth, refill my water bottle, and put the phone on the nightstand.
julian.intention: Keep the bedtime routine simple and protect sleep before the next workday.

julian.activity: Get into bed and review tomorrow’s departure plan briefly, then put on my sleep mask and rest.
julian.intention: End the day with the new schedule decided rather than mentally unfinished.
